name: Catechist
source:
Evangelist who leads souls to the Church.
Although he belongs to the Shinigami faction, he likes to keep himself neutral. He leads an observer type of existence.
Even though he's called "Catechist" his real name is unknown.
It seems he's even forgotten what his true self actually is.
He's a mysterious evangelist who keeps many mysteries to himself.
